description: This file implements the core logic of the FrameTimeline system in Android, including classes and functions for tracking, classifying, and tracing frame rendering and presentation events, with a focus on jank detection and performance analysis.

classes.name: FrameTimeline
classes.description: Main class managing the collection of display frames and surface frames, handling tracing, FPS computation, and frame management.

classes.name: SurfaceFrame
classes.description: Represents individual surface frames with timing, jank classification, and trace capabilities.

classes.name: DisplayFrame
classes.description: Represents a collection of surface frames for a single display refresh cycle, including timing, jank, and tracing.

classes.name: TraceCookieCounter
classes.description: Utility class for generating unique trace cookies.

methods.name: dumpTable
methods.description: Outputs timing information for predictions and actuals in a formatted table.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts various enum values to human-readable strings.

methods.name: jankTypeBitmaskToString
methods.description: Converts a bitmask of jank types into a comma-separated string description.

methods.name: toProto
methods.description: Converts internal enum values to protobuf enum values for tracing.

methods.name: getMinTime
methods.description: Returns the earliest timestamp among predictions and actuals.

methods.name: tracePredictions
methods.description: Outputs prediction timing data to perfetto trace.

methods.name: traceActuals
methods.description: Outputs actual timing data to perfetto trace.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Traces both predictions and actuals for a frame.

methods.name: createSurfaceFrameForToken
methods.description: Creates a SurfaceFrame object for a given token, with prediction status.

methods.name: addSurfaceFrame
methods.description: Adds a SurfaceFrame to the current display frame.

methods.name: setSfWakeUp
methods.description: Sets wake-up time and predictions for the display frame.

methods.name: setSfPresent
methods.description: Sets the presentation time and related data for the display frame.

methods.name: classifyJankLocked
methods.description: Classifies jank based on timing deltas and thresholds.

methods.name: onPresent
methods.description: Updates frame timing and classification upon presentation.

methods.name: computeFps
methods.description: Calculates FPS based on presentation times of layers.

methods.name: flushPendingPresentFences
methods.description: Processes pending fences and finalizes frame timing.

methods.name: finalizeCurrentDisplayFrame
methods.description: Moves current display frame to history and creates a new one.
